Unit 2 — Stats & Pickups

Coins, health, potions: the game gets a nervous system. This unit introduces the singleton StatManager, trigger-vs-collision physics, and the playtest ritual — the social skill that turns a build into a game.

Concepts this unit owns

The singleton pattern (a manager everyone can reach), the trigger vs collision distinction, and the playtest ritual belong to this unit forever. CED: AAP-2 (abstraction: one manager, many callers), AAP-3 (variables store program state).
